the height adjustment is controlled by a joystick on the seat connected to the Driving Position Node; the possible adjustments are: completely raising or lowering the seat or tilting backwards or forwards.The Driving Position Node is connected to two motors located under the seat for the adjustments.The potentiometric sensors connected to the motors are designed to memorize the seat position.When the speed of the vehicle exceeds 10 Km/h the adjustment of the driver's seat by recalling the position memorized is not possible.
